origin: Self-trained in kilix-brokeout's own simulation (tools/neural/brokeout_lab.c linked against game.o). No third-party data or weights.
outputs: 9 logits: where on the paddle face to strike the most urgent ball (far left .. far right); argmax each tick; game_apply_action moves the paddle there and launches a resting ball after 0.35 s

training.method: evolution strategies (antithetic, rank-shaped, Adam, sigma 0.05, lr 0.02, pop 64, 48 shared levels per generation, random level 1-20 and terminal 640x400-3840x2160)
stages: from scratch, 60 s episodes, lost-ball penalty 1.5: selected checkpoint generation 50
continued 200 generations, 120 s episodes, lost-ball penalty 3.0: selected generation 200
training.reward: share of brick hit points removed + (1 + up to 0.5 for a faster clear) - lost-ball penalty

selection.rule: highest clean-clear rate; progress breaks ties; then the smaller network

held_out.ship_rule: clean-clear rate beats the autopilot with non-overlapping Wilson intervals, ball-loss rate not worse with non-overlapping intervals, no level band worse: met. The ball-loss rates (7.05% vs 6.95%) overlap: no difference was demonstrated, which is not proof they are equal.
held_out.progress_metric: mean_progress is the share of the level's brick hit points removed
